title: Domain event envelope (contract v1, B.3)
description: One domain event, exactly as served by GET /api/integrations/v1/events, delivered by webhooks v2 (one event per POST, body = this envelope) and handed to EW plugins (IDomainEventSubscriberPlugin). The `data` shape per `type` is listed in ../event-catalog.v1.json.

id.description: evt_<ULID>. Globally unique; the dedupe key for consumers (also sent as X-Ever-Works-Event-Id).

seq.description: Feed position: assigned by Ever Works when it dispatches the event, strictly increasing and gap-free in the feed, so paging with `after` never misses a committed event.

version.description: Payload schema version of this event type. v1 of the contract only emits 1.

organizationId.description: Never null on the integration feed or webhooks: personal-scope events (organizationId null) are recorded for in-process listeners but never served to integrations.

version.description: The aggregate's version AFTER the change (A.4). For child events this is the PARENT's new version; for *.deleted it is the last version + 1; for task.runtime_updated it is the unchanged current version. Consumers skip a FULL-SNAPSHOT event whose aggregate.version <= the version already applied; child events and task.runtime_updated are applied by their own rules (spec.md §3), never skipped by version.

origin.description: Loop-prevention marker (C.2/C.4). `tag` is the X-Sync-Origin header of the write that caused the event (e.g. gauzy:<connectionId>), null for native EW writes.

changedFields.description: DTO field names that changed. Empty for *.created and *.deleted. For child events: the parent's set field that changed (e.g. ["assignees"]).

data.description: Full post-change snapshot in the integration DTO shape (B.6) named by the catalog for this type. Delete events: the last known snapshot plus `deleted: true`. Child events: the child DTO. *.visibility_changed to private: only {id, visibility: 'private'}.

previous.description: Previous values of changedFields only. {} when changedFields is empty.

correlationId.description: Optional request/run correlation id (e.g. the HTTP request id). Informational.
